name: SQL Injection
description: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an SQL Command.
remediation: Use parameterized queries, prepared statements, and validate inputs against a whitelist.
risk: Critical: Can lead to full database compromise and data exfiltration.

name: Cross-site Scripting (XSS)
description: Improper neutralization of input during web page generation.
remediation: Use context-aware output encoding, Content Security Policy (CSP), and sanitize HTML inputs.
risk: High: Can lead to session hijacking, defacement, and malware distribution.

name: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
description: The use of a risky or broken cryptographic algorithm can leave data vulnerable to decryption.
remediation: Replace legacy algorithms like MD5/SHA1 with modern standards like SHA256, AES-GCM, or Argon2.
risk: High: Data confidentiality and integrity are at risk.

name: Improper Authentication
description: Insufficient proof of identity claim validation.
remediation: Implement multi-factor authentication, secure session management, and robust password hashing.
risk: Critical: Unauthorized access to user accounts.

name: Path Traversal
description: External input used to construct paths to restricted parent directories.
remediation: Validate input paths, use whitelists, and canonicalize path names.
risk: High: Can lead to arbitrary file access.

name: Improper Input Validation
description: The product does not validate or incorrectly validates input that can affect the control flow or data flow of a program.
remediation: Implement strict input validation using allowlists and strongly typed inputs.
risk: Medium: Can bypass security checks or cause application crashes.

name: Exposure of Sensitive Information
description: Unauthorized exposure of sensitive information (e.g., credentials, PII, system details).
remediation: Ensure data is encrypted in transit/at rest and apply strict access control.
risk: Medium: Can lead to further targeted attacks or identity theft.

name: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
description: A web application does not verify a request was intentionally sent by the user.
remediation: Implement anti-CSRF tokens for stay-changing operations and use SameSite cookie attributes.
risk: High: Can perform actions on behalf of authenticated users.

name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
description: Untrusted data is deserialized without sufficient safety checks.
remediation: Avoid deserializing untrusted data; use safer formats like JSON instead of language-specific serialization.
risk: Critical: Can lead to arbitrary code execution (ACE).

name: Open Redirect
description: URL redirection to an untrusted site can be used for phishing attacks.
remediation: Avoid user-controlled redirect targets or validate against a whitelist of safe URLs.
risk: Low: Primarily used for phishing and social engineering.

name: Hard-coded Credentials
description: The use of hard-coded credentials (passwords, API keys) in source code.
remediation: Use environment variables or secure vault services to manage secrets.
risk: Critical: Exposed secrets can lead to full system compromise.

name: Code Injection
description: Improper control of generation of code allowed by external input.
remediation: Avoid dynamic code execution (eval, exec); use safer alternatives.
risk: Critical: Full remote code execution (RCE) capability.

name: XXE (XML External Entity)
description: Improper restriction of XML external entity references.
remediation: Disable DTD processing and external entity resolution in XML parsers.
risk: High: Can lead to file disclosure, SSRF, or DoS.

name: Unrestricted File Upload
description: Uploading files without checking extensions or content.
remediation: Rename uploaded files, check extensions against a whitelist, and scan for malware.
risk: High: Can lead to RCE via web shells.

name: Execution with Unnecessary Privileges
description: Running software with more permissions than required.
remediation: Follow the principle of least privilege; drop privileges after initialization.
risk: Medium: Exploit impact is amplified due to high privileges.
